title: Sim vs Real Approach Consistency
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=flightsim:session OR sourcetype=avionics:telemetry) event=approach
| eval src=if(sourcetype=="flightsim:session","sim","real")
| stats avg(glideslope_dev) as avg_dev, stdev(glideslope_dev) as consistency by src
| sort src
description: Compares how consistently you fly the approach glideslope in the simulator versus real flights.
value: Seeing sim and real approach precision side by side shows whether sim practice is sharpening the real thing.
implementation: Ingest approach data from both sources into `index=personal`; compare glideslope deviation.
visualization: Bar chart of approach consistency, sim versus real.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how steadily you fly the approach in the sim versus real flights, testing whether practice helps.
